class: document citation whose act is not a citation act

expect.why: `distinguishes` is an act one entry performs on another and a document may not; written in a document it is not matched by the citation pattern, so before this rule it sat in a checked document as prose nothing read

note: K27 is the near-negative: a document naming an entry in a parenthesis with no act at all, and again in running prose, neither of which is a citation shape. The rule fires on an id followed by a comma and an act-shaped word, which is a citation missing only a legal act.
